name: STOP
spec: red octagon, white border, white legend STOP
meaning: Come to a complete stop; go only when the way is clear and it is your turn.

snippets.back: Obey a stop sign where a separated pathway crosses a road entrance.
STOP AHEAD and YIELD AHEAD signs warn that a STOP sign or a YIELD sign is coming up.
Keep a parked vehicle at least thirty feet from a traffic signal, stop sign, or yield sign.
A driver behind the school bus must remain stopped until its stop sign retracts, red lights end and the bus moves again, or the bus driver signals permission to proceed.
At a STOP sign, stop at the marked line; with no line, before the near crosswalk; with neither, at the point nearest the cross street where you can see traffic.
When approaching a stop sign with a marked stop line, bring your vehicle to a complete stop before reaching the line.
When meeting a school bus with flashing amber lights, slow down and stop when the bus stops, its red lights flash and its stop sign extends.
A flashing red signal means the same as a STOP sign.

result.summary: Snippets require a complete stop at a STOP sign but never describe its shape, color, or legend.
